purpose: Frozen required-check/suite inventory and exact primary timing-field policy for W0-W8 comparisons. This file pre-registers what 'required PR-CI latency' means before any candidate sample is viewed; changes require an explicit reviewed plan amendment, never a quiet rewrite.
suite_membership_invariant: The fast suite membership (tests/run-tests.rkt --suite fast) and its shard mapping to 'test (0)'..'test (2)' are frozen at W0; new regression tests are enumerated in each wave's evidence and may never silently change suite membership or claim inventory (PLAN invariant 14).

primary_timing_definition.run_start_field: workflow run 'created_at'/'run_started_at' of the REQUIRED PR-CI workflow run (GET /repos/coinerd/q/actions/runs), earliest of the required parallel workflow runs on the head SHA
primary_timing_definition.run_end_field: 'completed_at' of the LAST required check run to complete on the head SHA (GET /repos/coinerd/q/commits/{sha}/check-runs, filter status=completed and name in required_pr_checks_branch_protection), accounting for required parallel workflows by the latest required completion
primary_timing_definition.check_name_policy: Exact check-run names as declared in branch protection (contexts list above); no normalization, no prefix matching, no failed-run substitution
primary_timing_definition.per_shard_duration_field: check-run 'started_at' to 'completed_at' of the individual 'test (N)' check runs; setup/compile time is the 'Set up Racket'/prepared-environment step window inside the job and is reported separately, never substituted
primary_timing_definition.excluded_from_primary: trigger-to-mergeable elapsed, queue time, runner-minutes — reported separately (PLAN invariant 14), cannot substitute
primary_timing_definition.quantile_helper: sorted observations, linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, milliseconds retained until display; W1 must implement and pin the exact helper with pr-latency-guard; this remains an outstanding W1 obligation — the pin is NOT in tests/test-ci-exit-truth.rkt; the earlier claim said otherwise and was corrected by the W0 review-fix (legacy rounded/midpoint helper is not reused)

cohort_eligibility_policy_preregistered.eligible_head: distinct PR head SHA with a complete truthful run of every required check above; first-attempt completions only; later green attempts never erase an original failure
cohort_eligibility_policy_preregistered.ineligible: docs-only/no-execution-change exempt PRs (NOT_APPLICABLE guard result), manufactured/dummy PRs, masked historical greens (BUG-0073 era), heads outside the declared cohort window or compilation regime
cohort_eligibility_policy_preregistered.disjointness: R2 cohort (>=20 heads) strictly after W4 activation merge; final cohort (>=20 heads) strictly after W6 decision; mutually disjoint and disjoint from v1.00.28/v1.00.29 samples
cohort_eligibility_policy_preregistered.traffic_basis: artifacts/ci-recovery/v1.00.30-w0/traffic-feasibility.json — 155 execution-change-candidate heads/30d observed, 0 validated clean eligible (historical masking); projected 7.7 calendar days at 1 head/day for 40 heads, 31.0 days at 0.25 head/day; cohorts remain OPEN until real eligible heads exist

bootstrap_note: W0/W1: no topology/compile-regime changes; existing security/result checks plus manual coordinator comparison apply until the pr-latency-guard is required (PLAN invariant 14).
